patch_description: This crossover combines effective-size threshold bin packing from the strongest prior implementation with multiple direct greedy seeds and strict move/swap local search from the current implementation. Binary searching a KVPR target converts the pressure constraint into a bin-packing capacity constraint, producing stronger initial layouts. Several packing and greedy orderings reduce sensitivity to fragmentation, and local search then accepts only operations that lower the true maximum KVPR while preserving memory feasibility.
